Overview

Hamilton is a city in WKO with a population of 185,000. A vibrant river city in the Waikato region, known for its agricultural research, university, and proximity to Hobbiton. Housing costs are close to the national average. The overall cost of living is below the national average. Gardening thrives here — the 6a growing zone supports Cool to mild — apples, pears, berries, many vegetables. Reported crime rates are relatively low.
